# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please describe the changes you made and the reason for the changes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Test addition
- [ ] Other

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's PEP 8 style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have added appropriate documentation (if needed)
- [ ] I have added unit tests for new functionality
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass
- [ ] I have added type hints where needed
- [ ] I have added docstrings for new functions/methods
- [ ] I have checked for hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] I have updated the FILE_GUIDE.md if file structure changed

## How Has This Been Tested?
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes work correctly.

## Screenshot (if applicable)
![screenshot](optional)

## Checklist for Reviewer
- [ ] Code review completed
- [ ] Tests passing
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities
- [ ] Documentation updated
